meta.titulo: Engine room classics and competition — Valentín Motors
meta.descripcion: Classic engine repairs for all makes: Porsche, Mercedes, Jaguar, Ferrari, Bentley, Aston Martin, Lamborghini and Alfa Romeo.

parrafos: With the help of Iván Bascuñana, head of the engine department, we have extensive experience in repairing classic engines of all brands. We also prepare engines for competition.
The following engines have passed through the hands of our motorcyclist, Iván Bascuñana:
items: Aston Martin DBS, DB4, DB5, DB6
Ford MK1, MK2 Pinto and BDG

secciones.titulo: We have experience repairing classic engines of any brand
parrafos: One of the departments we are most proud of is our engine room where we restore and upgrade the power and gearboxes of all 911 and classic Porsche.
In fact, our commercial name Valentín Motors comes from the name of the founder and “motors”, a symbol of the technical capacity that our company has had since 1979.
An engine room is very expensive at a technical and knowledge level, in fact not even the official dealers of the brands have one.

We have plenty of experience in Porsche engines, both air-cooled from the 356 to the modern GT3 and CUP; We do not limit ourselves to restoring and assembling according to original specifications but we also improve and enhance according to our calculations and data.

secciones.titulo: A workshop with engine room allows us not to depend on third parties, ensuring the warranty and the quality with which we execute our projects.

parrafos: Throughout the 964 generation Porsche used the 3.600 cc that provided so much reliability and satisfaction to its owners.
In the year 1991 the 911 turbo model was powered by a supercharged engine of 3,3 liters and 320 CV.

secciones.titulo: Interview with Iván Bascuñana, head engine builder
parrafos:
What moment is the most crucial or stressful in the process?
The moment of applying oil pressure already with the engine assembled and subsequently starting, which is where the result of the complete work is seen. There is a high degree of responsibility in the entire process since the costs are high.

What is the main quality that a motorcyclist has?
Mainly passion and continuous search for perfection.

What methodology for you is key?
Order and methodology of processes are key to the final result, the engine room is a closed, neat space in which everything is in harmony.

What is important to you, experience or technique?
The sum of the two is key, every day is a search for perfection and every day is a challenge.

What are the processes carried out in the engine room?
Disassembly, diagnosis of each part and checking of all engine elements.

What is the most important phase of disassembling or assembling an engine?
The most important phase of disassembly is the acquisition of information about the engine: making a prior diagnosis that will help focus on the process.
And in the assembly the verification of the motor tolerances. Tolerances of pistons and cylinders and oil clearance between crankshaft and connecting rod.

What type of measurements are made?
The entire set of measurements are important at the same level, piston/cylinder tolerances are the most important, but oil clearance and valve lift are also key.

Can we modify the factory parameters safely?
As a rule, all motors have a safety margin, the manufacturer abuses material and can be optimized without problems.

What advantages does a workshop have with a engine room?
Mainly, there is no dependence on third parties, which is a key issue in warranty and quality. It completely affects the quality that you want to offer to the customer.

Which process is the most complex?
Without a doubt it is the timing or drafting of timing at the time of assembly.
